title: NewsInterest
description: NEWS-00. One person's standing with one News channel (a topic or a source): whether they follow it, and a computed affinity from their own reads. Person scope: never readable by another person or an admin page, cleared by Reset My Mix (inferred rows) or Unfollow, removed by the person's forget rule. `inferred` is true when only the affinity holds the row; a child never has an inferred row (nothing is inferred about a child), which the cross-field rule in spec/records/ts/validate.ts (`validateNewsInterest`) enforces because JSON Schema cannot.

key.description: A topic id (spec/news/topics.json) or a `feed-` id.

affinity.description: Computed on the hub from the person's own reads; 0 for a row that holds only a follow.
